rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; HC data from the Brain Genomics Superstruct Project (GSP), explicitly described as a multi-site brain imaging study. Site-specific Euler index correction was applied across different sites.
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "data of 665 male participants were downloaded from the Brain Genomics Superstruct Project (GSP), a large-scale, multi-site brain imaging study (Holmes et al., 2015)"; "As the Euler index is closely related to the scanning site, we followed the approach proposed by Rutherford et al. to apply a consistent exclusion threshold across different sites."
